about_the_game:
Immerse Yourself in a Nightmare With No Escape

Andrey wakes up in an endless maze of corridors.

They seem vaguely familiar, but his memory is wiped, and reality distorts with every step. Voices from the darkness, children's screams, sinister shadows — what is this? Hallucinations, memories, or someone's cruel experiment?

Every movement changes the environment. Behind closed doors lies a truth Andrey doesn’t want to remember. But you can't run from the past.

Are you ready to remember what can’t be forgotten?

Game Features:

  • Psychological horror with a deep narrative – Uncover a dark mystery by piecing together fragments of the past.

  • A shifting world – The corridors have a life of their own, twisting and adapting to the protagonist's fears.

  • References to real events – Subtle details that will make you think twice.

  • Immersive sound design – Whispers behind your back, echoes of footsteps, and haunting noises pull you deeper into the atmosphere.

  • Photorealistic graphics – Powered by Unreal Engine 5.4, the horror feels closer than ever before

  • OS *: WINDOWS® 7, 8, 8.1, 10 (64-BIT Required)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-3470 or AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 760 2GB or AMD Radeon R9 280 3GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Are You Lost? Wander endless corridors where shifting environments, sinister voices, and echoes of real events create a chilling atmosphere. Andrey doesn’t remember who he was, but the walls know the truth. It’s time to remember everything.

English*, Russian
*languages with full audio support
